pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.Bf4
pages.notes: Overview said 6.Bf4 pressures d5 (it covers e5); plans put a knight on d4 over White's pawn, wrote e5 as a move and ...Ne4 with the knight on g8. Rewrote overview clause and both plans; British spelling, including Tarrasch Defence.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.Bf4 Nf6
pages.notes: Overview called the f4-bishop light-squared; plan 3 played Be2 and O-O before e3. Fixed both, plus plan 1's blockade timing; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.Bg5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 3 called 6.Bg5 a pin (it attacks the queen); plan 2 pushed d5-d4 into White's pawn; plan 4 called the e-file open. Rewrote all; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.e3 Nf6 7.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 4 sent the bishop to b7 and named rook squares as moves; plans 1-2 blockaded and pushed into White's d4-pawn. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.e3 Nf6 7.Be2 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d5-d4 into White's pawn; plan 2 used Nc3-b5 against d5. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.e3 Nf6 7.Be2 cxd4 8.Nxd4 Bd6
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed knights from d2, where there is none, while a knight already blockades on d4; plan 3 proposed a minority attack; plan 4 called the c- and e-files semi-open. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.e3 Nf6 7.Be2 cxd4 8.Nxd4 Bd6 9.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d5-d4 into the d4-knight; plan 2 blockaded on d5. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.e3 Nf6 7.Be2 cxd4 8.Nxd4 Bd6 9.O-O O-O 10.b3
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a b2-bishop not yet developed and blocked by the c3-knight; plan 2 pushed d5-d4 into the knight. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: von Hennig-Schara Gambit, 5.Qxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed ...Bg4 through the e6-pawn; plan 2 castled with 0-0 and no e3; plan 3 used open d- and e-files that are closed. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Tarrasch Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d5-d4 into White's pawn. Rewrote it; British spelling, including Tarrasch Defence.
